description: This file defines the class CollectEffectedSubjectIdsVisitor, which is a deprecated visitor implementation used to collect subject IDs affected by certain permissions within a resource tree structure. It traverses policy tree nodes, evaluates permissions, and determines which subjects are affected based on granted or revoked permissions.

classes.name: CollectEffectedSubjectIdsVisitor
classes.description: A deprecated visitor class for collecting subject IDs affected by permission changes within a policy resource tree.

classes.name: CollectEffectedSubjectIdsVisitor.ResourceNodeEvaluator
classes.description: Inner class responsible for evaluating resource nodes for permission effects on a specific subject.

methods.name: CollectEffectedSubjectIdsVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with a resource pointer and expected permissions.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Visits a policy tree node and delegates to subject or resource node visit methods.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the collected EffectedSubjectIds after evaluation.

methods.name: ResourceNodeEvaluator.aggregateWeightedPermissions
methods.description: Aggregates permissions at a resource node for its subject.

methods.name: ResourceNodeEvaluator.getLocationInRelationToTargetPointer
methods.description: Determines the position of a resource node relative to a target pointer.

methods.name: ResourceNodeEvaluator.evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates and adds subject IDs to the effected collection based on permissions.

methods.name: ResourceNodeEvaluator.areExpectedPermissionsEffectivelyRevoked
methods.description: Checks if permissions are effectively revoked for the subject.

methods.name: ResourceNodeEvaluator.areExpectedPermissionsEffectivelyGranted
methods.description: Checks if permissions are effectively granted for the subject.
